paths.note: Compare the same recorded point across independent accounts. These supplied scenarios have no probability weights.
book.note: One block represents one requested share. The outline marks shares confirmed by a report.
cost.note: Gross payment includes the price impact. Fees are a separate cash debit.
impact.note: Steps are equally spaced. Clock labels show the actual intervals; connecting lines only guide reading between recorded points.
lots.note: Each cell is one supplied candidate. Inspect its shares, remaining cash and feasibility. The selected result applies only to this finite search.
selection.note: Every trial uses the same zero and scale. The active row is being inspected; the selection marker records the chosen trial.
risk.note: Forecast and observed residual use the same squared-return units. Missing observations remain unrecorded.
